entities.name: Kiel
entities.description: A giant from Lorwyn, brother of Brion Stoutarm and Rosheen Meanderer, with some prophetic talents.

entities.name: Brion Stoutarm
entities.description: A giant of Lorwyn and Kiel's brother, killed by moonglove poison.

entities.name: Rosheen Meanderer
entities.description: The most renowned giant oracle on Lorwyn, sister of Kiel and Brion.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: A character who hired the giant brothers to eliminate a boggart raiding party.

entities.name: Eidren
entities.description: Leader of the Gilt-Leaf hunters who killed Brion.

entities.name: Endry
entities.description: Led groundling troops that captured Kiel in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A foe at the battle of Kinscaer who injured Kiel.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Opponent in the battle in the Wilt-Leaf Wood.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf Wood
entities.description: Where the giants were taken to be turned into vinebred servants.

events.summary: Brion and Kiel are ambushed by the Gilt-Leaf pursuit commando at the Festival of Tales and knocked unconscious by moonglove-poisoned arrows.
events.quote: both were struck by moonglove-poisoned arrows and knocked unconscious

events.summary: Brion is killed by moonglove poison thrown by Eidren, leaving Kiel and Rosheen without their brother.
events.quote: Brion was killed by moonglove poison thrown into his mouth by Eidren

events.summary: In Shadowmoor, Kiel is tracked down and captured by Endry and his groundling troops.
events.quote: Kiel was tracked down by Endry and his groundling troops, captured, and put to sleep.

events.summary: Kiel is injured at the battle of Kinscaer against Ashling.
events.quote: Kiel was injured in this battle

relations.quote: Kiel’s height equaled his brother Brion Stoutarm ’s
Kiel was also brother to Rosheen Meanderer .
Brion was killed by moonglove poison thrown into his mouth by Eidren
